set.prevailing_wage_basis: HOME: Davis-Bacon applies when a HOME-assisted rental project contains 12 or more HOME-assisted units (24 CFR 92.354); CDBG: Davis-Bacon applies to residential construction of 8 or more units (42 USC 5310). State prevailing wage may also apply under Labor Code 1720 depending on project facts.
